_meta.notes: Single pilot (Valentina) in a 1-seat Mk1 pod, in orbit.
_meta.source: Root-cause note (2026-07-28): this fixture's flat v.crew*/v.isEVA keys are kept below only because CrewStatus/dual-run.test.tsx still reads them directly to build its own stream emit. They no longer drive any render - CrewStatus migrated its own reads to the canonical one-arg useTelemetry('vessel.crew') + useStream('vessel.state') (see index.tsx, index.test.tsx, stream.test.tsx), which requires a real TelemetryProvider/TimelineStore fed via a '_stream' carriedChannels+emits block, exactly like every other stream-migrated widget's fixtures (FleetRoster, LaunchDirector). This fixture never had one, so the widget's crew read was permanently undefined and the render harness/visual-gate baseline show the empty 'No crew data' state - the widget itself was never broken, only the render-harness fixture was stale. The '_stream' block below is the actual fix: vessel.crew carries count/capacity/crew (Sitrep.Contract.VesselCrew), vessel.identity carries vesselType=0 (Ship, not EVA) so the derived vessel.state.isEVA resolves false (matching v.isEVA above), and vessel.orbit is emitted alongside it because deriveVesselState (vessel-state.ts) produces no record at all - isEVA included - until vessel.orbit is whole (see index.test.tsx's own ORBIT comment). Orbit numbers are a plausible circular ~87km Kerbin orbit; this widget never renders any orbit-derived field, so their exact values are illustrative, not a specific recorded pass.
